select ta.id as contract_id, ta.agreement_code as contract_code, ta.agreement_name as contract_name,ta.vendor_id,ta.scheme_id, tps.procurement_plan_type as procurement_type_code, tv.enterprise_name as vendor_name,tv.contact_name as vendor_main_contact,tv.contact_phone as vendor_main_contact_tel, taml.id as id,taml.materials_code as cost_item_code,taml.materials_name as cost_item_name,taml.brand as cost_item_brand,taml.specification as cost_item_specification,taml.unit_measurement as cost_item_unit,taml.count as cost_item_count, tbi.tax_unit_price as cost_item_unit_price, tbi.tax_unit_price * taml.count as cost_item_amount from tb_agreement ta left join tb_procurement_scheme tps on ta.scheme_id = tps.id left join (select v.id,v.enterprise_name,vc.contact_name,vc.contact_phone from tb_vendor v left join tb_vendor_contact vc on v.id = vc.vendor_id and vc.is_main_contact = 1) tv on ta.vendor_id = tv.id left join (select aml.id,aml.agreement_id,aml.materials_code,aml.materials_name,aml.brand,ml.specification,ml.unit_measurement,ml.count from tb_agreement_materials_list aml left join tb_materials_list ml on aml.materials_code = ml.materials_code) taml on ta.id = taml.agreement_id left join (select bi.scheme_id,bi.vendor_id,blq.materials_code,blq.tax_unit_price from tb_bidding_info bi left join tb_bidding_list_quotation blq on bi.id = blq.bidding_info_id) tbi on ta.vendor_id = tbi.vendor_id and ta.scheme_id =tbi.scheme_id and taml.materials_code = tbi.materials_code
ta.agreement_state = '3'
AND ta.agreement_code like concat('%',#{contractCode},'%')
AND ta.agreement_sign_date >= #{startTime} and ta.agreement_sign_date <= #{endTime}
